articles.title: Your skin’s chemistry may affect which mosquitoes you attract
articles.snippet: Three species picked their favorite human targets based on skin odor and bacteria. The findings could lead to the design of better repellents.
articles.summary: Three species of mosquitoes choose their favorite humans based on skin odor and bacteria. These findings could help scientists design better bug repellents.

articles.title: Circular cities go ‘green’ by reusing things over and over again
articles.snippet: To cut their wastes to nearly zero, circular cities are launching projects to repair, reuse and recycle virtually everything.
articles.summary: Circular cities are launching projects to repair, reuse, and recycle almost everything to cut their waste to nearly zero. This approach helps cities go green by reusing things over and over again.
